review_kind: author-operated cross-family source/evidence-receipt review; not independent merge desk or raw-evidence inspection

review.scope: 047 incoming notebook evidence and private console handoff; source-only review, not scientific acceptance. Review evidence limits, no inferred exit status, unchanged scientific gates, and system-owned stages. Assess whether saved original output resolves missing console to the stated extent.
findings: Evidence limits verified in source: inspect() reads only saved cell outputs (never cell source); SAVED_OUTPUT_CORRESPONDENCE_VERIFIED requires exactly one embedded-summary match with the contract in the same stream, otherwise CORRESPONDENCE_UNRESOLVED; the receipt hardcodes exit_status null, sibling_log_verified false, experiment_executed false, scientific_acceptance false, and records STUDY_COMPLETE/traceback presence as observations only — no exit status is inferred anywhere.

Missing-console resolution matches the stated extent and no more: docs claim only saved-output correspondence (semantic summary equality, single 9,466-byte stream, contract present), explicitly not complete-process-output attestation, not Drive sibling-log identity, and null (not zero) exit status because the old tee launcher never captured it; the reviewed code cannot produce a stronger claim than the docs make.

Private artifacts are fail-closed: fresh non-repo 0o700 destination under a private-permission parent, 'xb' writes, per-file byte readback plus original-notebook re-read, retained-summary byte-identity across both 40-hex pins checked before any write, 32 MiB size bound; failed intakes leave partial directories that later runs refuse (FRESH_PRIVATE_DESTINATION_REQUIRED) rather than repair or delete. provenance.json with the local source path stays in the private destination; the public intake JSON and stdout receipt expose only hashes, sizes and pins.

Console handoff recovery semantics are correct and tested: deterministic timestamp-free sort_keys receipt makes reruns idempotent; differing console bytes or binding, partial destinations, symlinked/empty sources, and repo-relative destinations all refuse without modifying stored bytes; existing destinations are verified via full inventory equality, never overwritten. Publication boundary semantics unchanged: merges and unpermitted paths (including later-deleted files and staged paths) refused, destinations never deleted, private handoff receipt never enters the publication bundle.

Scientific gates and system-owned stages preserved: the stage is a named, versioned, read-only 'incoming-notebook-evidence' receipt-bound pathway consistent with the operator's 2026-09-07 incoming-evidence clarification; nothing expands the public allowlist, relabels the prior exit-7 log or run_log.txt, alters the 17-required-artifact policy, or ratifies 047 landing/cleanup/acceptance.

Suggestion (identity binding): docs/science/047B_NOTEBOOK_INTAKE_20260907.json contains intake_implementation_sha256, a field the reviewed intake() never emits, so the recovery doc's 'binds the implementation hash' rests on an out-of-source augmentation that cannot be verified from this source alone; record which tool/version computed and appended that field.

Suggestion (binding overstatement): collect_console_handoff records the caller-supplied binding dict verbatim without validating it against the export inventory the docstring says it binds to; an empty or mismatched binding still yields PRIVATE_CONSOLE_COLLECTED.

Suggestion (correspondence strictness): summary equality uses Python ==, which conflates true/1 and 1/1.0, slightly looser than strict JSON-type equality; and intake() accepts source == replacement, making the retained-summary invariance check vacuous for identical pins — consider requiring distinct pins or recording the degeneracy.

Minor (permissions, mitigated by the 0o700 destination directory): notebook intake chmods files to 0o600 only after writing while the console handoff chmods before writing, and the console handoff omits the private-parent permission check that notebook intake enforces.

followup_disposition.implementation_hash: Public intake receipt augmentation by Astra used hashlib.sha256 on the versioned module bytes; private original stage receipt remains unchanged. See recovery document.

followup_disposition.strict_json_types: Suggestion retained; current original/replacement summaries and saved summary use expected numeric types. No broader validator equivalence claim.
followup_disposition.permissions: Private evidence directory protects file writes. Parent hardening suggestion deferred; existing repository prohibition and private directory remain.
